configs.description: Every adult-brain gene-tissue model enters jointly (a gene measured in k brain regions contributes k correlated models); prior 1e-3 per model (FOCUS paper default).

One model per gene: best cv.R2 across the 13 adult-brain weight sets; prior 1/(number of genes overlapping the LD block) = maintained FOCUS default gene set (bundled gencode_map_v38) placed on GRCh37 coordinates from GENCODE v38lift37 (the bundled gencode files are GRCh38 while our blocks are GRCh37).
As above but prior 1e-3 per gene (prior-sensitivity check).
One model per gene: adult-brain model if one exists, otherwise the best cv.R2 model from any of the other 39 weight sets (non-brain proxy tissue); prior 1e-3.
As joint_brain_gene_x_tissue_p1e-3 but with FOCUS --intercept, which regresses the average LD-tagged (non-mediated/pleiotropic) SNP signal out of the TWAS z-scores before fine-mapping.
As brain_prioritized_gene_p1e-3 but with FOCUS --intercept (see above).

Independent weight build: GTEx v8 EUR Brain_Cortex FUSION weights (gusevlab; heritable genes only, best-cv.R2 model per gene chosen by focus import); single tissue so one model per gene; prior 1e-3. Only this one v8 brain tissue was downloadable in the time budget.

blocked_methods.weights_source: none distributed (gene-tissue SuSiE eQTL models must be fit by the user)
blocked_methods.weights_build: n/a (would be GTEx v8 GRCh38 in the published analysis)
blocked_methods.blocker: TGFM ships no pre-fit gene-tissue models (Zenodo record contains only a 128 kB code zip). Step 1 (susie_eqtl_fine_mapping_for_tgfm.py) needs either individual-level eQTL genotypes + expression, or full eQTL summary statistics PLUS in-sample eQTL genotypes; for GTEx brain tissues both require dbGaP phs000424 controlled access (registration/approval not allowed here). Step 2 requires GWAS in-sample LD (the published analysis used UK Biobank genotypes; Davies 2018 has no in-sample LD, only 1000G EUR n=503), and Step 4 learns tissue priors genome-wide across all loci.
blocked_methods.notes: Not substituted with any weaker method.

blocked_methods.weights_source: would be PredictDB GTEx v7 brain elastic-net (GRCh37 rsIDs) or GTEx v8 mashr (GRCh38)
blocked_methods.blocker: Scope/time blocker, not an access blocker: cTWAS separates mediated from non-mediated (SNP) effects only after genome-wide estimation of gene and SNP prior inclusion probabilities and effect variances over all ~1,700 LD blocks, which needs genome-wide region/SNP maps and LD for every block plus multi-tissue weights; this did not fit the ~90 min / 3-thread budget alongside the running MAGMA job. A locus-only run with fixed priors would not be cTWAS as published.
blocked_methods.notes: Recommended next method: it is the one maintained tool that explicitly models non-mediated SNP effects rather than folding them into a NULL model.

extra.wall_clock_note: Work started ~09:30 UTC; FOCUS runs themselves take ~5-25 s per locus x configuration; the GTEx v8 cortex download (589 s) dominated.

downloads.source_authority: Link published by the FOCUS authors on the maintained repository wiki (https://github.com/mancusolab/ma-focus/wiki, Home and Creating-a-weight-database pages); hosted on Dropbox by the authors.
downloads.content: 52 weight sets: GTEx v7 PrediXcan ElasticNet (48 tissues incl. 13 brain) + FUSION CMC DLPFC, METSIM adipose, NTR blood, YFS blood. SNP IDs rsIDs; SNP and gene positions GRCh37 (verified: rs772921 stored at 12:56403577).

downloads.purpose: GRCh37 coordinates for the gene set of FOCUS's bundled gencode_map_v38.tsv (used only for the 1/n_genes prior).

downloads.content_check: RDat 'snps' use rsIDs with GRCh38 positions (rs12368145 at 12:55580188); pos-file P0/P1 are GRCh38 TSS; filtered pos = heritable genes (5,695).

method_assessment.FOCUS: RUN. Joint model over all gene(-tissue) expression models in an LD block plus an explicit NULL model; accepts GRCh37 1000G LD and rsID-keyed weights; no genome-wide step; seconds per locus.
method_assessment.MA-FOCUS: Same code base as FOCUS (the maintained repository); its multi-ancestry mode needs GWAS + LD + weights from >=2 ancestries. Davies 2018 is European-only, so only the single-ancestry FOCUS mode applies.
method_assessment.TGFM: BLOCKED - see CSV blocker text (no distributed gene-tissue models; individual-level GTEx genotypes needed to build them are dbGaP controlled access; needs in-sample GWAS LD; genome-wide prior learning).
method_assessment.cTWAS: BLOCKED (scope/time, not access) - see CSV blocker text.
method_assessment.GTEx_v8_other_11_brain_tissues: NOT DOWNLOADED: 11 further EUR brain archives of 198-231 MB each (~2.3 GB) at the observed ~375 kB/s would take ~1.7 h, beyond the budget.
